before: An image file pasted while a picture, shape, or text box was selected inserted nothing.
after: The image file inserts before the selected drawing's anchor run, at the drawing paste point, through the existing image insert operation. In suggesting mode the insert refuses with a reason, as the toolbar insert does.
reason: The paste writes through the released image insert path with a captured point target. Shared nodes, offsets, operations, and the collaboration format stay unchanged.
